# DeepSeek API Documentation

> > Official API documentation for DeepSeek's advanced language models including DeepSeek-V3.2, deepseek-chat, and deepseek-reasoner with thinking mode capabilities.

DeepSeek API provides access to state-of-the-art language models with features like reasoning mode, fill-in-the-middle completion, and structured JSON output. The API is OpenAI SDK-compatible and offers competitive pricing for both chat and reasoning tasks.

## Key Topics

- DeepSeek-V3.2
- deepseek-chat
- deepseek-reasoner
- thinking-mode
- chat-completions
- OpenAI SDK compatibility
- FIM completion
- streaming responses
- deepseek-v3.1-terminus
- JSON output
- token usage
- rate limiting
- Python SDK
- API pricing

## Getting Started

- [Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing): DeepSeek-V3.2, deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner pricing and features
- [Token & Token Usage](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/token_usage): Token definition, calculation, and billing for DeepSeek API
- [Rate Limit](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/rate_limit): DeepSeek API rate limit policy and HTTP connection guidelines

## Core Features & Guides

- [Thinking Mode](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode): Guide to using thinking mode with deepseek-reasoner and deepseek-chat
- [Multi-round Conversation](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/multi_round_chat): Guide for managing multi-turn conversations using chat/completions API
- [JSON Output](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/json_mode): Guide for structured JSON output using response_format parameter
- [FIM Completion (Beta)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/fim_completion): Fill-in-the-middle completion guide for code and content completion
- [V3.1-Terminus Comparison Testing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/comparison_testing): Guide for testing V3.2-Exp vs V3.1-Terminus with API endpoints

## API Reference

- [Lists Models](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/list-models): API endpoint to list available models with basic information
- [Create FIM Completion (Beta)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-completion): FIM completion API endpoint reference with parameters and streaming

## Code Examples

- [Thinking Mode Streaming Example](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode_api_example_streaming): Streaming API example for deepseek-reasoner thinking mode
- [Python SDK - V3.1 Terminus](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api_samples/chat_python_v3.1_terminus): Python SDK example for deepseek-v3.1-terminus chat API
- [Node.js SDK - V3.1 Terminus](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api_samples/chat_nodejs_v3.1_terminus): Node.js SDK example for deepseek-v3.1-terminus chat API
